column1: # tests/math/cases.tsv - M99. What each function in <math.h> is graded on.
# One row per function DECLARED in user_space/libc/include/math.h, and
# tools/math-test.sh fails if a declaration has no row here: a libm
# function nobody grades is the shape this file exists to prevent.
# kind  1  one double argument, swept over [lo, hi]
#       2  two double arguments, swept over the same grid pairwise
#       -  not graded by this harness; the note says why, and a note is
#          required, because "not graded" without a reason is the same
# rel_tol is what THIS project claims for the function, against the
# host's own libm as the answer. math.h says "around 1e-12" for the M63
# set and that is what most of these say. Where a row is looser, the note
# says what makes it so - a looser tolerance with no reason beside it is
# a bug that has been written down as a number.
